comment: Absolutely mesmerizing craftsmanship! The cobalt blue shade glows when the morning sunlight touches it. It came with a handwritten thank-you blessing from Master Rameshwar and was packaged with 100% paper and zero plastic. Truly proud to support our artisans.
artisanResponse: Dhanyawad Meera-ji. May the peacock bring prosperity and light to your home.

comment: You can smell the natural indigo and earth in this Ajrakh saree! The modal silk feels so cool and soft against the skin. The precision of the hand-carved wood block alignment is astonishing.
artisanResponse: Khatri Abdul Rahim: Shukriya Rhea-ji! Wearing natural indigo honours the water and desert land.

comment: Got this Channapatna train for my 2-year-old nephew. It's so smooth, no splinter or sharp corner anywhere, and knowing the colors are turmeric and natural lacquer gives immense peace of mind.
artisanResponse: Govinda Swamy: Blessings to the little child from our toy town!
